ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Social Services Fraud Crackdown
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's efforts to crack down on social services fraud, including the childcare funding freeze and other initiatives.
questions: What are the implications of the Trump administration's social services fraud crackdown?
How effective have these efforts been in reducing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the Trump administration's policies. By following the money and investigating the administration's efforts to crack down on social services fraud, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that have not been previously reported.
